findings.detail: dueLabel already returns the whole relative phrase (4m后 / 已逾期2h). '下次' + '4m后' with no separator renders '3 个唤醒 · 下次4m后' ('next 4m later'), a calque of 'next in 4m'; head.overdue already uses the clean '{head} · {label}' shape. The full-width colon keeps the source's 'next' and separates the two time expressions. The terser '{head} · {label}' is an equally valid alternative.

'1/3个需要处理' puts the generic classifier 个 after a ratio and leaves 需要处理 without a noun; it reads as 'one-third of an item needs handling'. Core's committed twin is '{shown}/{total}项需要关注' (tui.small.wake_panel.monitors_need_attention); 关注 is the softer, accurate 'need attention' and 处理 asks for action the header does not.

findings.detail: Core's committed zh-CN names the wake supervisor 监督者 in 14 strings (cli.wake_help.wake/status/install, cli.browser.supervisor_line); 监管 appears in core only as a verb (tui.schedule.notice_supervisor '没有进程监管这些唤醒'). 监管程序/唤醒监管 gives the same process a second noun. 下方唤醒 is a spatial calque; 以下唤醒 is the idiomatic text reference.

The value is consecutive_failures — failure occurrences, not a count of failed objects. 次 is the classifier for occurrences; core's tui.analytics.totals.calls_failed is '（{count}次失败）'. '3个失败' reads as three failed things.
